Expected Result: A loading or error state rather than a formatted zero.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while formatCurrency coerces a missing value to 0.00

Test Case Title: A market format with a null decimal separator still formats correctly
Preconditions & Test Data: A market whose format block returns decimal_separator as null.
Test Steps: 1. Render any amount through formatPrice.
Expected Result: The default separator is used.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the literal text null is printed inside the amount

Test Case Title: An omitted format field falls back to the default
Preconditions & Test Data: A market format block with fields omitted entirely.
Test Steps: 1. Render an amount.
Expected Result: The defaults apply and the amount is readable.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if an omitted key differs from a present null - omitted currently works

Test Case Title: Amounts format correctly across sign and magnitude
Preconditions & Test Data: A market with grouping and two decimal places.
Test Steps: 1. Format 0 and 0.5 and 1234.5 and -1234.5 and a very large value.
Expected Result: Grouping and decimals and the negative template all apply.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the negative_format template wraps the symbol and number

Test Case Title: Transaction amounts come from the server formatted value
Preconditions & Test Data: An account with credit and debit transactions.
Test Steps: 1. Open the transaction list. 2. Compare each row against the ledger.
Expected Result: Each row shows the server formatted amount with the correct sign.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if formatted_amount is rendered rather than a client computation

Test Case Title: The transaction list pages and filters correctly
Preconditions & Test Data: An account with more transactions than one page.
Test Steps: 1. Page through the list. 2. Apply each available filter.
Expected Result: No duplicates across pages and filters narrow the set correctly.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if paging and filtering compose

Test Case Title: An empty transaction history shows the empty state
Preconditions & Test Data: An account with no transactions.
Test Steps: 1. Open the transaction list.
Expected Result: The empty message renders rather than a blank table or an error.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the empty branch is distinct from the error branch

Test Case Title: A wallet balance covering the total completes without a gateway
Preconditions & Test Data: A balance at or above the payable amount.
Test Steps: 1. Select wallet at checkout and place the order.
Expected Result: No gateway opens and the balance is debited by the total.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the panel performs the debit

Test Case Title: A wallet debit and a failed order do not leave money missing
Preconditions & Test Data: A balance covering the total and an order that fails after the debit.
Test Steps: 1. Force the order to fail after the wallet debit. 2. Read the balance.
Expected Result: The debit is reversed or was never committed.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the panel makes the debit and the order atomic

Test Case Title: The wallet screen shows all four states
Preconditions & Test Data: An account with and without a balance and the panel offline.
Test Steps: 1. Load the wallet in each condition.
Expected Result: Loading shows the card loader - empty explains - failure shows an error with retry - loaded shows the balance.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if a failed fetch is distinguishable from a zero balance

Test Case Title: The recharge form is operable by keyboard and announces errors
Preconditions & Test Data: The recharge modal open.
Test Steps: 1. Traverse with Tab. 2. Submit an invalid amount. 3. Confirm the error is announced and linked to the field.
Expected Result: Every control is reachable and the validation error is announced.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the amount field has an associated label and error link

Test Case Title: A non-image file is refused as return evidence
Preconditions & Test Data: A delivered order item eligible for return.
Test Steps: 1. Start a return. 2. Switch the file dialog filter to all files and choose an SVG and then an HTML file. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: Both are refused with a message naming the file.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while only the count is capped

Test Case Title: An oversized image is refused as return evidence
Preconditions & Test Data: A delivered order item eligible for return.
Test Steps: 1. Start a return. 2. Choose an image well above 5MB. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: It is refused against a documented ceiling.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while no size check exists in the live component

Test Case Title: No more than five evidence images are accepted
Preconditions & Test Data: A delivered order item eligible for return.
Test Steps: 1. Select eight images at once. 2. Read how many are attached.
Expected Result: Five are kept and the customer is told the rest were dropped.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only on the count - currently the extra files are silently discarded by slice

Test Case Title: The panel validates evidence uploads independently of the client
Preconditions & Test Data: A valid token and an eligible order item.
Test Steps: 1. Post a return request directly to the API with an oversized non-image file.
Expected Result: Refused by the panel regardless of what the client would allow.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if server side mime and size validation exists

Test Case Title: Another customer order cannot be read
Preconditions & Test Data: An order slug belonging to a different account.
Test Steps: 1. Open /my-account/orders/{other-account-slug}/ while signed in.
Expected Result: Refused or not found.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the panel scopes the lookup to the caller

Test Case Title: Another customer order item cannot be cancelled or returned
Preconditions & Test Data: An order item id belonging to a different account.
Test Steps: 1. Call the cancel item and the return endpoints with that id.
Expected Result: Both refused.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if ownership is enforced on both

Test Case Title: A return request belonging to another customer cannot be cancelled
Preconditions & Test Data: A return request id from another account.
Test Steps: 1. Call the cancel return endpoint with it.
Expected Result: Refused.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the request is scoped to the caller

Test Case Title: A return cannot be raised for an item that is not eligible
Preconditions & Test Data: An item that is undelivered or outside the return window.
Test Steps: 1. Attempt a return for each case.
Expected Result: Both refused.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if eligibility is enforced by the panel and not only hidden in the UI

Test Case Title: A return quantity above the delivered quantity is refused
Preconditions & Test Data: A delivered item of quantity two.
Test Steps: 1. Request a return of quantity five.
Expected Result: Refused.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the quantity is bounded against the order item

Test Case Title: A reason requiring evidence cannot be submitted without it
Preconditions & Test Data: A return reason flagged as needing evidence.
Test Steps: 1. Choose that reason and submit with no photo and no remark.
Expected Result: Submission is refused with a message.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the needsEvidence guard holds

Test Case Title: Server side order errors render in the active language
Preconditions & Test Data: Language set to Arabic or Hindi and the orders endpoint failing.
Test Steps: 1. Force the failure. 2. Read the error panel heading and body.
Expected Result: Both render in the selected language.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the description is hard-coded English from getServerSideProps

Test Case Title: An invalid order identifier message is translated
Preconditions & Test Data: Language set to Arabic and a malformed slug.
Test Steps: 1. Request an order with a malformed slug. 2. Read the message.
Expected Result: It renders in the selected language.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the string Invalid order identifier is hard-coded

Test Case Title: Retry refetches the orders list rather than reloading the page
Preconditions & Test Data: The orders page showing its error state.
Test Steps: 1. Filter the list and set a page. 2. Force a failure and press retry. 3. Observe whether filters and scroll survive.
Expected Result: Only the failed request is retried and the view state is kept.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while onRetry calls window.location.reload

Test Case Title: Order list paging returns no duplicates and a correct last page
Preconditions & Test Data: An account with more orders than one page.
Test Steps: 1. Page to the end of the list. 2. Compare ids across pages against the total.
Expected Result: Every order appears once and the last page is not empty.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the page arithmetic matches the panel total

Test Case Title: Status and date filters narrow the list correctly
Preconditions & Test Data: An account with orders across several statuses and dates.
Test Steps: 1. Apply each status filter and then a date range. 2. Compare the results against the unfiltered list.
Expected Result: Only matching orders are shown and the total updates.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if filters compose with paging

Test Case Title: An account with no orders shows the empty state
Preconditions & Test Data: An account with no orders.
Test Steps: 1. Open the orders list.
Expected Result: The empty state renders with a primary action.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if empty is distinguishable from a failed fetch

Test Case Title: Every order status renders a coherent detail screen
Preconditions & Test Data: Orders in each supported status.
Test Steps: 1. Open the detail for each status in turn.
Expected Result: Each shows the correct status chip and the actions valid for it.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if no status falls through to a blank or default rendering

Test Case Title: Cancelling an item updates the order and the totals
Preconditions & Test Data: An order with two items in a cancellable status.
Test Steps: 1. Cancel one item. 2. Re-read the order.
Expected Result: The item shows cancelled and the totals reflect the change.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the detail refetches after the mutation

Test Case Title: An order past the cancellable window cannot be cancelled
Preconditions & Test Data: A shipped or delivered order.
Test Steps: 1. Attempt to cancel it through the UI and then directly through the endpoint.
Expected Result: Both refused.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the panel enforces the window rather than the UI alone

Test Case Title: Reordering adds the original items to the current cart
Preconditions & Test Data: A past order whose products are still sellable.
Test Steps: 1. Reorder. 2. Read the cart.
Expected Result: The items are added and anything unavailable is reported.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if unavailable items are surfaced rather than dropped

Test Case Title: Reordering across a market change reports unsellable items
Preconditions & Test Data: A past order placed in a different market.
Test Steps: 1. Switch market. 2. Reorder that order. 3. Read the cart and any notice.
Expected Result: Items not sellable in the active market are named rather than silently omitted.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the response failure list is surfaced

Test Case Title: The orders list and detail show all four states
Preconditions & Test Data: An empty account then a populated one then the panel offline.
Test Steps: 1. Load each screen in each condition.
Expected Result: Loading shows a skeleton - empty explains - failure shows an error with retry - loaded shows the data.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if a failed fetch is never rendered as an empty list

Test Case Title: The order detail and return sheet are operable by keyboard
Preconditions & Test Data: An order eligible for return.
Test Steps: 1. Traverse the detail with Tab. 2. Open the return sheet and complete it by keyboard. 3. Close with Esc.
Expected Result: Every control is reachable and focus is trapped and restored.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the sheet traps focus

Test Case Title: Order screens hold at every breakpoint
Preconditions & Test Data: An order with many items and long product titles.
Test Steps: 1. Load the list and the detail at 375 and 769 and 1280.
Expected Result: Layout holds with no horizontal page scroll and actions stay reachable.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if long titles do not force overflow

Test Case Title: An absolute notification URL does not navigate the customer off site in place
Preconditions & Test Data: A notification whose payload sets redirect_url to an external origin.
Test Steps: 1. Deliver such a notification. 2. Open the notifications screen and click it.
Expected Result: The customer is not navigated off site in the same tab.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while handleNavigate calls router.push with the raw value

Test Case Title: A protocol relative or javascript scheme notification URL is refused
Preconditions & Test Data: Notifications carrying //evil.tld and a javascript scheme target.
Test Steps: 1. Deliver each and click it.
Expected Result: Neither navigates anywhere unsafe.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while quickLink is returned with no scheme check

Test Case Title: Push notification links keep their new tab and noopener handling
Preconditions & Test Data: A push notification carrying an external URL.
Test Steps: 1. Deliver it and click the toast.
Expected Result: It opens in a new tab with noopener and noreferrer.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the scheme test at FirebaseInitializer is preserved - this path is currently correct

Test Case Title: Typed notification links resolve to internal routes only
Preconditions & Test Data: Notifications of each supported type with slugs.
Test Steps: 1. Deliver one of each type and click through.
Expected Result: Each lands on the matching internal route.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the typed branches keep building relative paths

Test Case Title: A non-image avatar is refused
Preconditions & Test Data: A signed-in account on the profile screen.
Test Steps: 1. Switch the picker filter to all files and choose an SVG and then an HTML file. 2. Save.
Expected Result: Both are refused with a message.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the handler stores whatever the picker returns

Test Case Title: An oversized avatar is refused
Preconditions & Test Data: A signed-in account on the profile screen.
Test Steps: 1. Choose an image well above the ceiling used elsewhere in the app. 2. Save.
Expected Result: It is refused against a documented ceiling.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while no size check exists

Test Case Title: The panel validates the avatar independently of the client
Preconditions & Test Data: A valid token.
Test Steps: 1. Post a profile update directly with an oversized non-image file.
Expected Result: Refused by the panel.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if server side mime and size validation exists

Test Case Title: A failed profile fetch shows an error rather than an empty form
Preconditions & Test Data: The panel failing on the profile endpoint.
Test Steps: 1. Open the profile screen with the endpoint failing. 2. Read what renders.
Expected Result: An error state with a retry - not an editable blank form.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while getServerSideProps substitutes an empty object

Test Case Title: Saving a profile that failed to load cannot blank the stored record
Preconditions & Test Data: A profile screen rendered blank after a failed fetch.
Test Steps: 1. Press save without editing anything. 2. Re-read the stored profile.
Expected Result: The stored name and email and country are unchanged.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the form submits empty strings for every field

Test Case Title: Email verification status refreshes without a full reload
Preconditions & Test Data: An account with an unverified email.
Test Steps: 1. Open the profile. 2. Verify the email in another tab. 3. Return to the profile tab.
Expected Result: The verification state updates when the tab regains focus.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the page reads the frozen SSR snapshot rather than Redux

Test Case Title: A profile update is reflected on the screen that made it
Preconditions & Test Data: A signed-in account.
Test Steps: 1. Change the mobile number through the profile flow. 2. Read the value shown without reloading.
Expected Result: The screen reflects the saved value.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the page never reads the refreshed Redux state

Test Case Title: Privileged fields submitted with the profile update are ignored
Preconditions & Test Data: A valid token.
Test Steps: 1. Add a role or permission or wallet balance field to the profile form payload. 2. Submit and re-read the account.
Expected Result: None of the extra fields is applied.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the panel whitelists the accepted fields

Test Case Title: Changing the email requires proof of control before it takes effect
Preconditions & Test Data: A valid token.
Test Steps: 1. Submit an email change to an address you do not control. 2. Re-read the account and attempt password recovery to the old address.
Expected Result: The change is pending until verified and recovery still reaches the original address.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the panel holds the new address pending verification

Test Case Title: Another customer address cannot be read or edited or deleted
Preconditions & Test Data: An address id belonging to a different account.
Test Steps: 1. Call the show and update and delete and set-default endpoints with it.
Expected Result: All four refused.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if every call is scoped to the caller

Test Case Title: A supplied owner id in the create payload is ignored
Preconditions & Test Data: A valid token.
Test Steps: 1. Create an address including another account user id.
Expected Result: The address belongs to the caller.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the owner is taken from the session

Test Case Title: Deleting the address selected at checkout clears that selection
Preconditions & Test Data: An address selected at checkout.
Test Steps: 1. Select it at checkout. 2. Delete it from the addresses screen. 3. Return to checkout.
Expected Result: The selection is cleared and a new address is requested.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the checkout copy is never reconciled

Test Case Title: The address list refreshes after every mutation
Preconditions & Test Data: An account with several addresses.
Test Steps: 1. Add then edit then delete an address. 2. Read the list after each.
Expected Result: The list reflects each change without a manual reload.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if each handler awaits mutate - currently correct

Test Case Title: Another customer wishlist cannot be read or modified
Preconditions & Test Data: A wishlist id belonging to a different account.
Test Steps: 1. Call the read and update and delete and move-item endpoints with it.
Expected Result: All refused.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if both source and target are scoped on the move endpoint

Test Case Title: Removing an item rolls back visibly if the server refuses
Preconditions & Test Data: A wishlist with items and a panel that can be made to fail.
Test Steps: 1. Remove an item with the endpoint failing. 2. Observe the list.
Expected Result: The item returns and an error is shown.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the optimistic update revalidates on failure - currently correct

Test Case Title: Marking a notification read is reflected in the unread count
Preconditions & Test Data: An account with unread notifications.
Test Steps: 1. Open one notification. 2. Read the unread badge.
Expected Result: The count decreases by one.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the badge derives from the same source as the list

Test Case Title: Every account screen shows all four states
Preconditions & Test Data: An account with and without data and the panel offline.
Test Steps: 1. Load profile and addresses and notifications and wishlists in each condition.
Expected Result: Each shows loading then empty or error or loaded appropriately.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL on profile which renders a blank form on failure

Test Case Title: Server side account errors render in the active language
Preconditions & Test Data: Language set to Arabic and the addresses endpoint failing.
Test Steps: 1. Force the failure. 2. Read the error panel.
Expected Result: Heading and body both render in the selected language.
Pass/Fail Criteria: FAIL while the description is hard-coded English

Test Case Title: Account forms are operable by keyboard and announce errors
Preconditions & Test Data: The profile and address forms.
Test Steps: 1. Traverse each with Tab. 2. Submit invalid values. 3. Confirm each error is announced and linked to its field.
Expected Result: Every field has a label and every error is linked and announced.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if aria-describedby links errors to fields

Test Case Title: Account screens hold at every breakpoint
Preconditions & Test Data: An account with long names and addresses.
Test Steps: 1. Load each account screen at 375 and 769 and 1280.
Expected Result: Layout holds with no horizontal page scroll and the sidebar behaves per breakpoint.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS only if the account layout switches correctly at the 1024 cutover
